comment: * An RFC 2045 Media Type, * appropriate to describe the content type of an HTTP request or response body. * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: public static MediaType parse(String string)
methods.comment:
* Returns a media type for {@code string}, or null if {@code string} is not a
   * well-formed media type.

methods.name: public String type()
methods.comment:
* Returns the high-level media type, such as "text", "image", "audio",
   * "video", or "application".

methods.name: public String subtype()
methods.comment:
* Returns a specific media subtype, such as "plain" or "png", "mpeg",
   * "mp4" or "xml".

methods.name: public Charset charset()
methods.comment:
* Returns the charset of this media type, or null if this media type doesn't
   * specify a charset.

methods.name: public Charset charset(Charset defaultValue)
methods.comment:
* Returns the charset of this media type, or {@code defaultValue} if this
   * media type doesn't specify a charset.

methods.name: public String toString()
methods.comment:
* Returns the encoded media type, like "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
   * appropriate for use in a Content-Type header.
